title: Creep purple
description: This is a PVP texture pack in the color purple.
body:
Who doesn't love purple? Purple is my favourite color so i made a texture pack in PVP style with the color purple.

The creative inventory has a gradient from purple to blue. Most things have a blue purple gradient or a recolor to purple like the tnt the and the fire charge. This is an early alpha version of my pack. My goal Is to change every texture from  items and blocks  that you can buy in the Hypixel Bedwars store(shop keeper) and every PVP item.
